2 — Content hint on entry and PiP layout changes

For testing only, not a PiP fix. Close PiP before changing the mode, then open the same video in a new PiP window. Keep the video unchanged during the test. Playback and seek buttons work, but their icons do not update in diagnostic modes. Switching video or re-entering PiP in the same Activity ends the experiment and restores normal behavior. Enable extended player diagnostics and record a new session for each mode. After testing, select Normal mode.
PiP experiment ended: normal behavior restored. Close PiP and reopen the same video for a new test.
